description: Attach a distinct fresh function symbol to each existential occurrence in a prenex prefix. Its arity is the number of preceding universal quantifiers; an initial existential therefore receives a constant symbol.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Skolemization.Prenex.Symbol.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Skolemization.Prenex L n → ℕ → ℕ → Type (max u v)
